reviewNotice: This is an in-progress paper kit. Section 6 is completely triaged: ten numbered items provisionally match, while the n=2 statements in Lemma 6.8(iv) and Theorem 6.2 are directly refuted by an independently audited, nonvacuous actual 2-ADC counterexample. The same omitted class refutes the binary Theorem 1.9(ii) and changes Theorem 1.10 from +1 to +2; an exact corrected six-family catalogue is proved. Every dyadic branch of Theorem 1.10 has an exact complete and irredundant integral-isometry catalogue, with the printed binary count kept separate from its correction. Both parts of Lemma 4.6 have actual-lattice endpoints for every dyadic parity, column, and source-rank branch. In the non-dyadic interface, Proposition 4.2(ii)-(iii), Lemma 4.4(i)-(iii), and both directions of Lemma 4.5 are derived from determinant-Hasse-Hilbert and codimension criteria; Lemma 4.6 reuses those proofs, so ambient exactly-one, target-pair, and unique-excluding-space conclusions are no longer fields. Remark 4.3 maximal-row exhaustion and row irredundancy are now derived from Proposition 4.2(ii), Lemma 4.4(i), and maximal-lattice uniqueness rather than stored as CatalogueLaws fields. Concrete local-field instances remain pending. For the non-dyadic branch, the finite-catalogue deduction remains conditional on explicit arithmetic classification laws, but publisher Table 4.7 itself is concretely certified at the symbolic row, rank, Jordan-rank, exact unary/binary-domain, and rank-four case-split levels. The full non-dyadic Lemmas 4.7(ii), 4.8, 4.14, and Propositions 4.15--4.16 deductions are proved from explicit cited O'Meara, realization, maximal-lattice existence and uniqueness, maximal-overlattice, same-rank transfer, representation transport, and deletion-witness laws; Lemma 4.8 and Proposition 4.15 are no longer final-conclusion fields, while concrete local-lattice instances remain pending. The finite logical layers of Corollary 1.8 and Theorem 1.11 are proved. All 48 publisher Table 1 matrices, their printed discriminants, exact rational positive definiteness, and the literal 21-row last-column selection are concrete, but the Hanke-Kirschmer-Oh catalogue identifications and actual local checks remain explicit inputs. Lemma 2.2 is fully formalized for every number field and finite-place completion. O'Meara 63:9 is proved internally from the principal-unit filtration, so the unary, Corollary 7.21, corrected binary, and all dyadic Theorem 1.10 numerical formulas have no caller-supplied counting premise. Theorem 7.1 is proved, but its printed proof omits the second boundary class. Section 7 has 20/21 fully formalized numbered items; Lemma 7.13 has a printed quantifier mismatch. Every numbered deduction in Sections 5 and 8, plus Theorems 1.5 and 1.7, is proved from explicit law packages; the class-number-one regularity step is derived from lower genus-lifting and isometry-transport laws, while their concrete non-dyadic and number-field instances remain pending. Reports 26-73 give the scope. The newest exact clean Review Kit receipt is recorded separately from later source changes. GitHub-hosted exact-tag CI and artifact upload, remaining arithmetic and external-catalogue instances, release promotion, and human sign-off remain separate gates.
